info.name: Kompare - Authentication
info.description: Authentication API documentation matching the current Kompare backend. Import the companion environment and select it. All accounts, passwords, OTPs and response tokens are fictional examples. Replace email with an inbox you own; enter the actual emailed OTP. Send requests individually: this is not an unattended runner because email codes require manual input. Successful login/refresh saves both tokens. Password reset clears local user tokens and updates the environment password to new_password. Superadmin login uses separate variables. SMTP must be configured on the server. Never put server SECRET_KEY or SMTP credentials in Postman. Examples are illustrative, not recorded live responses. See README.md for complete flows and constraints.

request.description: Public. Set password_reset_otp to the actual reset-email code and new_password to a password of 8–128 characters. The frontend compares password and confirmation; do not send confirm_password (extra fields are rejected). OTP verification and password change happen together in this request; there is no separate reset-code verification endpoint. Success consumes the code and revokes all existing access/refresh sessions. Log in again. The script updates the environment password and clears local user tokens. Default five failed attempts per code.

Password: 8–128 characters. This endpoint does not send the normal user registration verification email.
